# Abeona Therapeutics® Announces Participation in Upcoming Investor Conferences


November 10, 2026 7:30am EST


CLEVELAND, Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Abeona Therapeutics Inc. (Nasdaq: ABEO) today announced that members of its management team will participate in upcoming investor conferences in November 2026:


- Stifel 2026 Healthcare Conference: Fireside chat on Wednesday November 11, 2026, at 8:40 AM Eastern Time (ET) and investor meetings.


- Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference: Presentation on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 10:30 AM Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) and investor meetings.


Live webcasts of the fireside chat and Company presentation can be accessed on the Investors section of the Abeona website under “Events” at[https://investors.abeonatherapeutics.com/events](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Kym-jXl0Ca9B0fk7p5mWkeTJyEWsDRrDC287w5Id7xWqAaa5-ti-XpoGA3FNqro9j3VtejfVFz9pKACrH7eEM2y3VHR3NI3WiAkhC75nVZQjsAX-kk8pFK75X7e6gJ41BesWFoOg9dzD1ZsxNcunn9Jt5c23VL8CZWLvE__ixeEogwdSeMG_CjW2SSjNwsXiZaj6UB0coe2BnJ5x6hVSY8_Dz3JxzyZiCppIXlZqGSZvFR7I-hYW48ZyrERxR1SYqr3v6IArtRCQF0PbWcnnBNZAH2Tq5l1jOB8DznEGujnW-cxfNjBJRfJuyE7oyW74L0Dd6Ku6z3y4Kam9o8OJF5suXiEq8jz5kCnEqZBJCvzDYxxgLHXHwliMuvW7gbMpN44U-wVBra6pq-4OfxItgQ==) , where replays of available events will also be accessible for a limited time.


**About Abeona Therapeutics**


Abeona Therapeutics Inc. is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company building a portfolio of therapies for rare and serious diseases with multiple opportunities for value creation. The Company’s portfolio includes ZEVASKYN® (prademagene zamikeracel), the first and only autologous cell-based gene therapy for the treatment of wounds in adults and pediatric patients with recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa; ABO-801, a Phase 3-ready product candidate for eosinophilic esophagitis; and ABO-701 (PSMA-SIR-T™), an investigational engineered T-cell therapy targeting PSMA. For more information, visit[www.abeonatherapeutics.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Nl_eILuoA6twK56IwqttHoGPr6BCebBubr6KkqE6WLN6LYNXhwc9_pjl2eJGeRPl0Tg9YwgemAiyEhKbFThkjakZn-A7OiGvlxbEafiOFQ9Y6fbOWnSXuD3zz1mGbty-) .
